identification: Six framed pictures: (1) coloured wood engraving 'Launceston, from Cataract Bridge' (Picturesque Atlas of Australasia, c.1886-88, after F.B. Schell), (2) framed watercolour of a church and fountain in park (Launceston?) signed Geoff Tyson '63 (Geoffrey Tyson 1911-86, Launceston-born watercolourist), (3) small engraving 'Post Office, Launceston', (4) second framed copy of the Post Office, Launceston print, (5) botanical print of Dutch iris (Iris xiphium), (6) small unsigned oil of a blue mountain landscape. Only the Tyson watercolour is a named artist; the atlas print is a modest decorative print.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 50-70, current bid $10. The prize is the Geoff Tyson watercolour: his market is about A$300-350 at regional rooms for 34-37 x 54 cm landscapes (Lawsons Sept 2025), with MutualArt showing a record of about US$557 since 2021 (Leski 2025 listings also exist). The Armitage example is a smaller-looking church/fountain scene dated 1963, so check size, signature, foxing and whether it is under glass. Also note a Geoff Tyson 'Coal River at Richmond' 34 x 54 cm is estimated 250-350 in this same Armitage sale. Prices are 2025, rising slightly. The rest is decorative.
